`CLICKHOUSE_PROMETHEUS_METRICS_ENDPOINT` now accepts an `http://` or `https://` URL as well as a bare `host:port`. With `https://`, the collector's `prometheusremotewrite` exporter sends metrics over TLS and verifies the server certificate against the system CAs. Previously the exporter always used plain HTTP, so an HTTPS-only endpoint could not receive metrics. This applies to both standalone and OpAMP-managed colle

The `/api/v1/prometheus/*` routes now take `sourceId` instead of `connectionId`, and read the connection and TimeSeries table from that PromQL source. Caller-supplied `database`/`table` params are ignored for ClickHouse and no longer forwarded to external Prometheus endpoints. Saved PromQL chart configs now require `source` and no longer persist `connection`, so provisioned dashboards with PromQL tiles must set `source`.

The API alone, as `quay.io/keydrahq/keydra-backend:0.0.1`.

Only needed for a split deployment, where the API and the interface run as two Deployments.
The ordinary installation is the single image built in
[keydrahq/keydra](https://github.com/keydrahq/keydra), which carries the interface inside it
so one container answers both and nothing has to be told where the API lives. Pair this with
`quay.io/keydrahq/keydra-ui:0.0.1`.
